def result(name):

 if p.is_file():
  assert p.stat().st_size<16*1024*1024
  raw=p.read_bytes();d=json.loads(raw);m=d.get('metrics',{});a.update(reference={'file':str(p),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(raw)},lifecycle={k:d.get('_meta',{}).get(k) for k in ('start','end','exit_code')},metrics={k:m[k] for k in ('kind','status','passed','all_owned_units_ended','errors','cleanup_errors','gates','unit_claims','unit_runs','producer_exit_code','devices') if k in m})
